title: Erase Selected Fills is a silent no-op — StageArea/Shell never pass selectedFaceFilter to planarEraseShape
description:
VERIFIED by code inspection (grep: selectedFaceFilter appears ONLY in packages/core/src/engine/planar/eraser.ts). The 'Sel' eraser mode button shipped in task 1387 (ToolsPanel.tsx ERASER_MODES:580-592) but neither caller supplies the predicate the engine requires:
- StageArea.tsx:3230-3233 (interactive erase) passes only {mode, insideAt};
- Shell.tsx:1726-1731 handleEraseOnLayer (agent/oracle bridge) likewise.
planarEraseShape mode 'selected' (eraser.ts:183-185) skips EVERY face when opts.selectedFaceFilter is absent, so with fills selected on stage the mode erases NOTHING (fills or lines). Real Flash 8: Erase Selected Fills erases only the currently-selected fills (strokes untouched, unselected fills untouched).

SUGGESTED FIX: build the predicate from the current selection and thread it into the StageArea erase path: whole-object selections -> point-in-shape-fill over the selected ShapeDisplayObjects (selectedShapeIds is already available in Shell/StageArea); partial planar sub-selections (SubSelection face keys) -> pointInFace over the selected faces of the live planar map. Pass the same predicate from handleEraseOnLayer given ids. Note: planarEraseShape's contract (predicate over the face's interior point in stage space) already fits both.

ACCEPTANCE: with two fills on a layer and only one selected, dragging the eraser in 'selected' mode across BOTH erases area from the selected fill only; with nothing selected it erases nothing; engine test planar-eraser.test.ts:638 already covers the kernel — add a wiring-level test (StageArea handler or a timeline-level helper) so the regression can't silently return.

Related: 1387 (added the button but not the filter), 1322 (engine modes). Found by brush/eraser Flash-8 fidelity audit.
